title: Grateful Dead Live at County Coliseum on 1973-11-23

ai_review.summary: A high‑quality soundboard capture of the late‑1973 El Paso show, famed for its massive He's Gone → Truckin' → The Other One jam and a soaring Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source with clear vocals and well‑balanced instruments, letting listeners hear every nuance of this marathon 2‑hour first set and the spectacular second‑set suite. Reviewers rave about the seamless He's Gone > Truckin' > The Other One > Jam > Bobby McGee sequence, the fiery Jerry Garcia solos, and the sweet Eyes of the World, declaring it one of the underrated gems of the band’s prime ’73 era.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average ~4.1) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and sound quality; only a few outlier negative opinions that reflect personal taste rather than objective flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, front‑center vocals (including Donna Jean), crisp mix with no reported dropouts or major muddiness; reviewers note the sound is better than typical 1973 recordings.

standout_songs: He's Gone > Truckin' > The Other One > Jam > Bobby McGee
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon 17‑song first set (≈2 hrs) that builds momentum, followed by a second set dominated by extended, jazzy jams and seamless transitions; the show’s pacing is praised for its balance of tight songs and exploratory improvisation.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly described as 'on fire', with perfect tone and soaring solos, especially on The Other One and Eyes of the World.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboard work noted for driving a two‑note riff that underpins the long jam sequence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's fast, rollicking bebop rhythm during The Other One highlighted as part of the high‑energy second set.
